judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are P2 (rank 1) Knowledge Objectives under the same Sub-Topic Area 'Whole Numbers' within Topic Area 'Numbers and Operations', so the grain and statement type match. Content differs substantively: the first describes how to add and subtract numbers 0–200 (Unit 1, operations knowledge), while the second covers reading and writing numbers up to 1000 in numerals and words (Unit 3, numeration/representation knowledge). Symmetric relatesTo reflects the genuine conceptual coherence without claiming sequence. Both endpoints' source evidence is truncated (24 omitted items each) and all context nodes carry upstream audit/merge context, which limits confidence but does not contradict this reading.
